Before this declaration was committed, #1288's and #1320's frames and walks were built once at the 18:00 instant and once at the 16:00 instant of the commit before #1312's merge (29732943), and the per-cell scores of the two were compared for equality (no table, no interval was computed, no figure of this study was read). amendments: The per-cell scores of (s3c), (s3c-ann) and (s3c-ann-net) were equal at 16:00 and at 18:00 on every one of the 10,100 cells (9,275 development, 825 on the 2026 days) in the scratch comparison made before this declaration was committed; 20 development-window cells (the five leads of four decision days: 2020-04-06, 2023-01-09, 2025-09-08 and 2025-10-27) carry a different scarcity-state label, because #1145's state (the own-leg grid, `scripts/state_calendar_1145.py` `decision_states`) is read at the decision instant and a series it reads is public between 16:00 and 18:00 on those days. The model's own state is held at its maximum (s3c_net.constant_states) and the label only groups cells in #1320's state split (Table 4c), so no score moves; the study reports the four days and does not investigate the series further. These per-cell scores came from the current tree running at 16:00, see the next amendment, so they show that the code and data of the two trees agree, not that the instant is without effect.

Found while running, before any figure of this study was read: the unchanged scripts of #1288 and #1320 took their decision instant from one hard-coded `DECISION_TIME = time(16, 0)` in scripts/spread_mean_reversion_686.py (every script of the family reads it from there), so a first run of them on this tree was a run at 16:00 and wrote #1288's record byte for byte. scripts/spread_mean_reversion_686.py now reads RMM_DECISION_TIME from the environment (default 16:00, and 18:00 the only other admitted value), so every earlier script and test stays at 16:00 and the 18:00 runs of this study set it; `score` refuses to run unless the family's instant is 18:00 (`require_instant`). The runs of #1288's and #1320's scripts were repeated with it set.
